# HELP llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total Total number of processed prompt tokens
# TYPE llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total counter
llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total 1100
# HELP llamacpp:prompt_seconds_total Total prompt processing time
# TYPE llamacpp:prompt_seconds_total counter
llamacpp:prompt_seconds_total 5.5
# HELP llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total Total number of generation tokens
# TYPE llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total counter
llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total 150
# HELP llamacpp:tokens_predicted_seconds_total Total generation time
# TYPE llamacpp:tokens_predicted_seconds_total counter
llamacpp:tokens_predicted_seconds_total 1.5

# TYPE llamacpp:requests_processing gauge
llamacpp:requests_processing 1
# HELP llamacpp:requests_deferred Number of requests deferred

llamacpp:requests_deferred 0
